name: get_product
description: Look up a single product by its product_id and return its name, category, price and current stock level.

name: search_products
description: Search the product catalog by a free-text query matched against product name and category. Returns matching products.

max_results.description: Maximum number of products to return. Defaults to 10 if omitted.

name: get_order
description: Retrieve a single order by its order_id, including its status, line items and total.

name: list_orders
description: List all orders belonging to a customer, optionally filtered by order status.

status.description: Optional status filter. One of PENDING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED (case-insensitive).

name: create_order
description: Create a new PENDING order for a customer from a list of line items. Validates stock and computes the total.

customer_id.description: The customer the order belongs to, e.g. 'C-900'.

items.description: The line items to order. Each item references a product and a quantity.

quantity.description: How many units of the product to order. Must be a positive integer.

name: cancel_order
description: Cancel an existing order by order_id. Orders that are already DELIVERED or CANCELLED cannot be cancelled.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason for the cancellation.
